narrative.intro: Northrop Grumman Systems has $2.9B in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Northrop Grumman Systems received 2 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $1.4B and obligations up 124.5% year over year. Northrop Grumman Systems has returned to FY23 obligation levels after a dip in FY25, following a trend line that runs $1.1B in FY21, $2B in FY22, $2.9B in FY23, $3.5B in FY24, $1.3B in FY25, and $2.9B in FY26. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is the dominant market for Northrop Grumman Systems in FY2026 to date, accounting for $2.9B in obligations. Northrop Grumman Systems also records activity in Engineering Services, with $1.2M in obligations for the period. The current-year totals are partial, covering fiscal year to date, and the listed award-value tables use total contract values rather than current-year obligations. These figures describe the firm’s federal revenue mix and recent year-to-year change, useful for contract strategy and program planning.
